## Judgment

## Change
- pi-durable input moves from 7d8b3eb to 2a7c310 (Gitea #46-#56): team members keep their work trees over a harness restart, file artifacts and long messages are readable by teammates, a fan-out without items splits the goal first, New session shows only what a distance uses, and the session page is inert while another session opens.
- lib/bincache-push.nix: the post-build hook drops the deprecated `warn-short-path-literals` alias from the NIX_CONFIG that the daemon hands it. Nix 2.35 printed a deprecation warning on every hook call.

## Evidence
- pi-durable `scripts/ci.sh` on 2a7c310: all gates passed (2369/2369 tests, zero evaluation warnings, vm-service, vm-haproxy and vm-factories on petunia).
- The hook filter was tested with a NIX_CONFIG that holds the alias and two other settings: only the alias line is removed.

## Risk
- The hook keeps every other daemon setting. A failed push still never fails a build.
